purpose: Teach: 重厚/緑茶/木星/レンガ/交響楽/ブドウ/焼き鳥/安楽

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、重厚な雰囲気だな
lines.en: Your place has a really heavy vibe to it, you know?
lines.style: Casual observation, almost teasing. Sits back. Watches for his reaction. Light and present.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットボトルの緑茶ばっか飲んでんな、桜
lines.en: You just drink bottled green tea all the time, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry wit. Small smile underneath. Mirrors her observation style back at her. Equally casual but sharper.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、理科で木星の単元やったろ?
lines.en: You did that Jupiter unit in science, right?
lines.style: Leading question, testing. Genuine curiosity hidden under teen surface-level chat. Eyes watching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図工でレンガっぽい工作したろ?桜
lines.en: You made that brick-looking craft project in art class, remember? Sakura?
lines.style: Turns it back on her. Same pattern. Slightly smug. But also noticing—genuinely interested in what she made.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、吹奏楽部だろ?交響楽もやんの?
lines.en: You're in the wind band, right? Do you do orchestral stuff too?
lines.style: Softer this time. Actual interest breaking through. Less defense, more genuine asking. Leans slightly forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でブドウ狩り行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went grape picking, didn't they? Sakura?
lines.style: Matches her pattern again. A rhythm developing between them. Understated, noticing the small things she does.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、焼き鳥好きだろ?
lines.style: Simple, direct. The game quieting down slightly. Getting to something real underneath the banter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、安楽な生活すんなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't just live an easy life, Sakura.
lines.style: Shift—sharper, quieter. The teasing falls away. Delivery firm but not unkind. This matters. Eye contact steady.
